heavy_spectrum: mH=mA=mHplus in GeV at each pole benchmark; second point holds signed Z6 fixed and uses the small-mixing branch.
scope: Real tree-level scalar potential, extra Yukawa in original texture basis at a common matching scale; ordinary mass and CKM are calibrated, not outputs. Heavy mass, orthogonal Yukawas and Z6 are independent choices. A pole means tree mass eigenstate; no loop pole or charged-scalar flavor fit.
